expected.finding: **[P1]** **Escaped quotes leave password contents in published reports.** In [improvement_policy.py:106](scripts/improvement_policy.py#L106), the assignment and flag patterns stop at an escaped quote. For example, `--password [REDACTED]` becomes `--password [REDACTED]"`. I reproduced the suffix surviving into the miner’s public JSON and human report, which the workflow prints to Actions logs. Handle escaped delimiters and shell quoting before truncating or publishing credential values.

**[P2]** **Repository filtering accepts unrelated projects and rejects valid SSH remotes.** In [mine-trace-failures.py:226](scripts/mine-trace-failures.py#L226), matching `github.com/acme/service` accepts `acme/service-other` through substring matching and `elsewhere/service` through the directory fallback. Conversely, `git@github.com:acme/service.git` is rejected when its checkout directory has another name. These cases contaminate or omit evidence used to revise policy. Compare normalized repository identities exactly; use directory matching only for explicitly configured folder matches.
